context.summary: Found by audit run 2 (F-2026-11-23-4). GitHub issues #30 and #31 name the two decisions as pending, raised in #25. `ekumen decision list` has neither. The T-claude-adapter amendment of 2026-11-23 tells the session to keep the implemented recommendations and says the lead will decide after merge, so the tier-2 choice is effectively made by the code that merges. Review verdicts for this stack also live in GitHub issue #32, while earlier reviews (T-log-fixes) were recorded as ekumen questions.

options.tradeoff: A session raises decisions with a separate small commit or PR to main (or asks the orchestrator to raise it there). The inbox stays the one place to look. Costs one extra merge per decision.
The loop also reads DecisionRaised events from open PR branches and shows them as "pending, on branch". No extra merge, but the inbox depends on observed state and branch events may never merge.
No change. Branch decisions wait for merge; the orchestrator mirrors urgent ones by hand (GitHub issues today).

data.question: T-claude-adapter raised D-claude-bg-workspace-trust and D-claude-hooks-policy-blocked on its PR branch (#25). They are not on main, so `ekumen inbox --for lead` never shows them; they were tracked as GitHub issues #30 and #31 instead, and the session kept building on its own recommendation. How should a decision raised on a branch reach the lead?
data.title: Make decisions raised on a task branch visible to the lead before merge
